description: Features from the monthly balances of earlier Home Credit credit cards, one row per applicant. Built in notebooks/11_credit_card_eda_features.ipynb.

CC_MONTHS_SINCE_LATEST_ROW.definition: Months from the latest row of any card to the application.

CC_SHARE_OVER_LIMIT.definition: Share of months with a limit in which the balance exceeded it.

CC_SHARE_WITH_BALANCE.definition: Share of months with a balance above zero.

CC_BALANCE_LATEST.definition: Balance in each card's latest row, if within 3 months; summed over cards.

CC_LIMIT_LATEST.definition: Limit in each card's latest row, if within 3 months; summed over cards.
CC_LIMIT_LATEST.warning: Differs between train and test (stage 8, rule 1): keep with a warning: the limits on offer are the same in both files; the difference is in how many cards have a recent row.

CC_LIMIT_GROWTH.definition: Latest limit above zero over the first limit above zero; the highest over cards.

CC_SHARE_ATM.definition: Share of months with a cash withdrawal. A missing withdrawal amount counts as none.
CC_SHARE_ATM.warning: Its distribution differs between train and test in fine detail (stage 8).

CC_N_ATM_12M.definition: Number of cash withdrawals in the last 12 months.

CC_SHARE_UNDER_MIN.definition: Share of due months (a minimum above 1 recorded) in which less than the minimum minus 1 was paid.

CC_SHARE_PAID_NOTHING.definition: Share of due months in which nothing was paid.

CC_PAY_TO_BALANCE_MEAN.definition: Average over months with a balance of the amount paid over the balance, capped at 1.

CC_PAY_TO_MIN_MEAN.definition: Average over due months of the amount paid over the minimum, capped at 5.

CC_MAX_DPD.definition: The largest days past due under the tolerance rule.

CC_N_DEMAND.warning: Differs between train and test (stage 8, rule 1): keep with a warning: a card in Demand is rare (12 development applicants) and more than twice as common in test.

CC_N_CARDS.definition: Cards with monthly rows. 0 when there are none.

CC_MONTHS_BACK.definition: How far back the card record goes, in months.

CC_UTIL_MEAN.definition: Average over months of balance over limit, where the limit is above zero, never below zero.

CC_UTIL_LATEST.definition: Utilisation in each card's latest row, if within 3 months; the highest over cards.

CC_UTIL_MEAN_12M.definition: Average utilisation over the last 12 months.

CC_ATM_TO_LIMIT_MEAN.definition: Average over months with a limit of cash withdrawn over the limit.

CC_SHARE_ARREARS.definition: Share of months past due under the tolerance rule (SK_DPD_DEF above 0).

shift_note: Test applicants hold cards more often (34% against 28%) and started them later relative to the application. A model given all 22 candidates told the files apart at 0.78.
properties_verified: Each applicant's features depend on that applicant's rows only.
An independent rebuild of 521 applicants agrees on all 22 features.
No row is dated on or after the application.
selection_note: One feature was dropped using development outcomes (rule 3). The holdout was not used.
